## What changes and why

## Checks run

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] `make web-checks`, for a change to the web page, its styles or templates
- [ ] `make e2e`, for a change to the transport, the session, the scanner, the daemon's reconnect or the simulator

## Commits and docs

- [ ] Each subject reads `Area: a plain sentence`, one change per commit, and no trailers or attribution lines
- [ ] The docs that describe the change are updated

The maintainer makes the version bump (and its changelog section) at the merge, unless you were
told to make it yourself; see [Versions](https://github.com/RRAlex/svolder/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#versions).
